calendar.name: AXIOM protocol
calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subscribe_note: Subscribing keeps a calendar following this card: a compound added later appears without anyone re-scanning the code. Apple Calendar refreshes within hours; Google Calendar refreshes on its own schedule, which can take considerably longer.
calendar.download_note: The download is a copy as it stands. After a compound is added, download it again.

edit.title: Adding a compound
edit.body: AXIOM sends a sign-in link to the email address on file for this account. That link opens the card for editing.
edit.sent: If this account has an email address on file, a link is on its way there.
edit.no_contact: This account has no email address on file. Contact AXIOM on WhatsApp.
